Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 042. 最近请求次数

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class RecentCounter {
public:
    deque<int> q;

    RecentCounter() {
    }

    int ping(int t) {
        q.push_back(t);
        while (q.front() < t - 3000) {
            q.pop_front();
        }
        return q.size();
    }
};

/**
 * Your RecentCounter object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * RecentCounter* obj = new RecentCounter();
 * int param_1 = obj->ping(t);
 */
